scripts.desktop:dev: set ELECTRON_DEV=1&& concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r = spawnSync('npx', ['electron-rebuild','-f','-w','node-pty'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (r.status !== 0) { console.warn('node-pty rebuild failed; terminal will fall back to pipe mode.'); }"
